methodology: YES is classified as right-aligned and NO as left-aligned when the Arizona Republican Party supported the proposition and the Arizona Democratic Party opposed it. Candidate classifications use the party label in the election results. Green, No Labels, write-in, judicial retention, and unclassified choices are excluded from partisan baselines.
